story.title: Ava's Kitchen Science Lab
story.introLine: Hi Ava! Are you ready to become a scientist and explore how things change?
story.closingLine: Now it is your turn to predict what happens next in our experiment!

scenes.title: The Three States
scenes.narration: Look at these items on the counter! We have a solid ice cube, a glass of liquid water, and a steaming kettle. Everything is made of matter, but they all look and feel very different. Can you see the tiny bubbles in the steam?
scenes.imagePrompt: A bright, colorful kitchen with a wooden table holding a clear bowl of ice, a glass of blue water, and a whistling tea kettle with soft white vapor. Polished 2D children educational game art style.

scenes.title: The Heat Experiment
scenes.narration: What happens if we add heat to our solid ice? It starts to wiggle and flow! Matter can change its state when we change the temperature. Let's use our tools to see if we can turn this solid into a liquid together.
scenes.imagePrompt: Ava's character standing by a sunny window with a magnifying glass, looking at a melting ice cube turning into a small puddle on a colorful plate. Polished 2D children educational game art style.

narration.transcript: Hi Ava! Are you ready to become a scientist and explore how things change? Look at these items on the counter! We have a solid ice cube, a glass of liquid water, and a steaming kettle. Everything is made of matter, but they all look and feel very different. Can you see the tiny bubbles in the steam? What happens if we add heat to our solid ice? It starts to wiggle and flow! Matter can change its state when we change the temperature. Let's use our tools to see if we can turn this solid into a liquid together. Now it is your turn to predict what happens next in our experiment!
